key_catalyst: Escalating U.S.-Iran Geopolitical Tensions and Oil Price Surge
reasoning: The escalation of U.S.-Iran military conflict into a sixth day of airstrikes has driven oil prices higher and spiked September Fed rate-hike odds to 73%, presenting a severe and novel macroeconomic threat to growth stocks. Despite a recent pre-market bounce, the combination of escalating geopolitical risk, an extended semiconductor selloff, and ongoing sector rotation remains unresolved and actively threatens the tech-heavy QQQ.
